# Amprius Technologies Announces Date for First Quarter 2026 Results and Business Updates


April 21, 2026 8:30 am EDT[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_433739fff1c1ca150231c0ca841605ec/amprius/news/2026-04-21_Amprius_Technologies_Announces_Date_for_First_163.pdf)


FREMONT, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--[Amprius Technologies, Inc.](https://amprius.com/) **("Amprius"), (NYSE: AMPX)** , a leader in silicon anode lithium-ion batteries, will hold a conference call and webcast on Thursday, May 7, 2026 at 8:30 a.m. Eastern time (5:30 a.m. Pacific time) to discuss its financial results for the first quarter ended March 31, 2026. Financial results will be issued in a press release prior to the call.


Amprius management will host the presentation, followed by a question-and-answer period.


**Date:** Thursday, May 7, 2026
**Time:** 8:30 a.m. ET (5:30 a.m. PT)
**Toll-Free Number:** 866-424-3442
**International Number:** 201-689-8548
**Webcast:**[Register and Join](https://event.choruscall.com/mediaframe/webcast.html?webcastid=jgWyNUF3)


Please call the conference telephone number 5-10 minutes prior to the start time. An operator will register your name and organization. If you have any difficulty connecting with the conference call, please contact Gateway Group at 949-574-3860.


The conference call will be broadcast simultaneously and available for webcast replay[here](https://event.choruscall.com/mediaframe/webcast.html?webcastid=jgWyNUF3) .


**About Amprius Technologies, Inc.**


Amprius Technologies, Inc. is a leader in advanced lithium-ion battery technology, delivering high-energy and high-power silicon-anode batteries with up to twice the energy density, range, and flight time of conventional graphite-based cells. Headquartered in Fremont, California, Amprius operates an R&D lab and pilot manufacturing facility for silicon anodes and cells. To support scalable production, the Company employs a contract manufacturing strategy, enabling rapid capacity expansion with minimal capital investment. Committed to driving innovation in energy storage, Amprius powers next-generation applications in aerospace, defense, and mobility. For additional information, please visit[amprius.com](https://amprius.com/) and the Company’s[LinkedIn page](https://www.linkedin.com/company/ampriustechnologies/posts/?feedView=all) .
